Tool names here are Academic Harness's own. In Claude Code, `subagent` is `Agent`, `skill` is `Skill`, `ask_user_question` is `AskUserQuestion`, and `mcp__papermemory__*` is `mcp__plugin_academic-harness_papermemory__*`. If a tool named below is not in your tool list, say so.

## Submission and communication

`submission_pack` is the pre-upload checklist and bundle builder: `plan` checks limits, figure specs, citations, reporting evidence, numerical candidates, required statements, sections, and reviewers; unknown requirements are `manual_check`, never passes. `build` assembles the PDF/source, figures, supplement, statements, cover letter, highlights, checklist, and a SHA-256 manifest into a reproducible zip; `status` and `export` inspect or copy it. It never submits, emails, or logs into a portal, and a call-to-action is not a readiness verdict.

- `journal_search` `action: "match"` ranks venues from title/keywords/metrics and constraints; fit is advisory, and predatory-venue signals need manual due diligence.
- `numbers_audit` reports numerical-reporting candidates (recomputed p-values, CI/estimate consistency, N, flow counts, percentages, table/text values) and lists what it could not check. It never claims statistical validity.
- `manuscript_diff` produces latexdiff/Markdown diffs, changed blocks, DOCX tracked changes/comments, and a response-letter skeleton; an item is never marked addressed without a real hunk behind it.
- `rebuttal` keeps an advisory reviewer-response coverage ledger under `.dsh/rebuttal/<slug>/`: import a stored `deep_review` round, `ah_review` items, or the `openreview` reviews this session already has (it never fetches), plan supplementary task stubs capped by `REBUTTAL_MAX_TASKS` (the paper's `N_t` is never instantiated here), link existing `experiment_log`/`analysis_run` runs by digest-pinned id (it never executes), and record the author's own answers and declines — a decline with `ah_item` is verified against the engine's live `declined` status, one without is stored labelled unverified. Coverage counts whether a point was answered with cited evidence, never whether the answer helped: a `bad`/`engineer` verdict, `spec_drift`, a drifted digest, or a non-zero exit stays recorded beside the point it was run for. Inside an `ah.yaml` project the engine remains authoritative for item status and the response letter; the ledger prints its own evidence-linked reading beside it and warns when they diverge. Nothing gates a turn — only `ah_check` blocks.
- `presentation_build` fills known sections and figures into a poster or slide deck. A successful compile is not a visual pass — render the pages and inspect them with `read_image` on an image-capable model.
- `authorship` records authors, CRediT roles, and ICMJE criteria. It never assigns author order, decides qualification, or invents an affiliation, ORCID, funding source, or conflict.

Load `submission-package`, `manuscript-revision`, `numbers-audit`, `presentation-build`, `authorship-credit`, or `rebuttal-experiments` for the detailed workflow; use `journal_search` `match` with the `academic-search` skill.
